items.headline: Alibaba previews 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Max-Preview is a 2.4-trillion-parameter multimodal model, the first Qwen model above one trillion parameters to handle images, video and documents. Alibaba claimed it ranks second only to Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 but released no model card or benchmark data with the preview.
